thread:
Aisha Nadar: FYI Cobalt customer seeing p99 timeouts after canary deploy at ~08:12 PDT. Support flagged this as a P0. Need decision: rollback immediate or targeted hotfix? SLO risk. @eng-sre @eng-runtime
Ellie (support): Escalation inbox — logs show KV cache misses and an OOM in pool-3. A few sessions timed out, customer is asking for ETA.
Ben Cho: I can own the hotfix. Likely culprit is the kv_cache_size default change in 02b7. If we decide to rollback, who triggers canary rollback (eng-releases or platform ops)?
Carlos Mendez: I can trigger rollback if needed. Rollback would restore previous model variant + config. Downtime should be negligible but want explicit signoff.
Dana Li: Note: rollback will remove recent batch/quant tweaks and may increase cost. Hotfix plan: revert kv_cache_size param and restart model pods in affected pool. Estimate ~45m to test + deploy.
Aisha Nadar: OK decision: try hotfix since customer sessions and data matter. Ben/Dana pair to patch. Carlos — stand by to rollback if hotfix fails in 40m. Ellie to communicate ~2h ETA to customer until confirmation.
Ben Cho: Opening PR and pinging reviewers now. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/PR/8123 Title: runtime: revert kv_cache_size default change. @Carlos Mendez @Dana Li
deploy-bot: deploybot: CI green, integration tests passed for PR 8123 on branch hotfix/cobalt. Staging deploy queued.
Carlos Mendez: I'm prepped to do canary rollback if patch fails. Verifying dedicated pool routing so rollback won't affect unrelated customers.
Dana Li: Quick command I'll run after merge to force rolling restart in pool-3: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-pool-3 -n inference --timeout=10m``` I'll tail logs during restart.
Ben Cho: :thumbsup: Merged PR 8123. Starting staging deploy. Tagging @Aisha when staging looks good.
Aisha Nadar: Staging looks clean after ~20m load tests, p99 within normal range. Proceeding to prod patch. Carlos, hold rollback for now.
Carlos Mendez: :ok_hand: Holding. If we observe >5% error delta I'll trigger rollback and notify immediately.
Ellie (support): Updated customer: "We have a targeted patch going to prod with ETA ~45m. We'll update you if anything changes." Customer rep: "Thanks for the quick response."
deploy-bot: prod deploy started for hotfix/cobalt, rollout timestamp 2025-03-17T16:40:00Z.
Ben Cho: Prod patch completed. Monitoring metrics now. Initial telemetry shows p99 back to baseline. Marking Ben/Dana as owners for 24h watch.
Aisha Nadar: Thanks everyone. Action items: Ben/Dana — postmortem + RCA in #postmortems within 72h; Carlos — verify routing config audit; Ellie — confirm customer follow-up & close P0 if stable. I'll file a tracking ticket and add milestones.
